description: This file defines the DateTimeNormalizer class for serializing and deserializing DateTime objects within Drupal, handling formats like RFC3339 and ISO8601, and managing timezone configurations.

classes.name: DateTimeNormalizer
classes.description: Handles normalization and denormalization of DateTime objects to and from RFC3339 and ISO8601 formats, considering system timezone configurations.

methods.name: doNormalize
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to a string in RFC3339 format, setting explicit timezone.

methods.name: getNormalizationTimezone
methods.description: Retrieves the system's default timezone for normalization.

methods.name: denormalize
methods.description: Converts date strings or timestamps into DateTime objects, supporting multiple formats.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns supported types for normalization, specifically DateTimeInterface.
